design_tradeoffs: Auto JSON failure uses a separately validated native observation; explicit JSON mode preserves strict refusal.
Rejected-row grace is two polls and identifiable rows only, balancing brief corruption against membership liveness.
Use existing inspection allowance for one-shot details; no new unbounded bypass.
Analysis memoization preserves walltime/memory/account/scientific cohort identity even when it reduces cache hits.
Incremental greedy coverage changes complexity without claiming globally optimal revalidation.
Keep explicit original timestamps and missing ranges rather than silently interpolating independently sampled collectors.
